answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the meadow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
